data.text: Damage from a distance. Deal damage with sound at some place.

logic.description: Implemented. Delta damage (Rule 21) to one enemy within 2 hexes (ranged: the only target-scope effect with range 2). Right-clicked enemy within 2, else the enemy hurt most within 2; Aura widens to all enemies within 2, Aura ∀ to enemies within 10. ∀ double cast has no extra bonus.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).
No declared target (the engine picks the enemy the cast hurts most within 2) or the right-clicked target is within 2 hexes; through an Aura ∀ the reach is the whole view (10).
A declared target must be an enemy (exactly one side is npc_b); without one the engine aims at an enemy itself.
A declared target must still be alive (life > 0); dead units are skipped.

effects.description: Rule 21 (pc): Σ over the cast elements of max(caster stat − defender stat, 0), ÷10, rounded half up; a Force Shield die is subtracted from the Σ before rounding (peer side).
Hex reach of the cast (the "from a distance" of the paper).

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_air (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
